flagship.name: Software-Defined Photonics Hackathon
flagship.motto: Build Software Tools and AI Models for Photonics
flagship.intro: Egypt's premier competitive hackathon to develop open-source design automation tools, simulation accelerators, and machine learning models for optics and photonics.
flagship.description: The Software-Defined Photonics Hackathon brings together undergraduate engineers, graduate researchers, and software developers across Egypt. Teams build production-ready Python tools, train inverse-design neural networks, and curate open photonic benchmarks that empower the global optics community.
flagship.format: Hybrid (Virtual Build Sprint and In-Person Finale)

tracks.title: Software Tools Track
tracks.description: Build open-source Python libraries, layout automation scripts, GDSII and OASIS DRC utilities, or electromagnetic solver acceleration packages.
exampleTopics: Automated optical routing and waveguide curve optimization
Fast FDTD pre-processing and post-processing libraries
Open-source optical circuit design rule checking (DRC) engines

tracks.title: AI Models Track
tracks.focus: Machine Learning and Neural Inverse Design
tracks.description: Develop deep learning surrogates, inverse-design neural networks, or physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to predict or optimize optical device behavior.
exampleTopics: Deep learning surrogates for micro-ring resonator spectra
Inverse design of compact grating couplers using adjoint methods
Neural network prediction of fabrication tolerances in silicon photonics

tracks.title: Open Datasets Track
tracks.description: Curate and publish labeled datasets of simulated or experimentally measured photonic components to establish global community benchmarks.
exampleTopics: Curated silicon photonic component S-parameter libraries
Broadband transmission spectra of fabricated directional couplers

tracks.title: Integration and Toolchain Track
tracks.description: Create plugins, converters, or workflow adapters linking standalone tools like gdsfactory, Meep, and EDA suites into unified design pipelines.
exampleTopics: Automated export from Meep simulations to gdsfactory layout components
Interactive JupyterLab widgets for photonic parameter sweeps
Open-source schematic-driven layout (SDL) generators for PICs

phases.description: Teams register, select their challenge track, access starter repositories, and attend technical onboarding masterclasses.

phases.phase: Phase 2: Sprint and Mentor Office Hours
phases.description: Intensive development sprint with weekly check-ins and dedicated mentorship sessions with academic and industry experts.

phases.phase: Phase 3: Repository Submission and Code Review
phases.description: Teams submit public GitHub repositories with clean documentation, unit tests, and reproducible Jupyter demonstration notebooks.

phases.phase: Phase 4: Judging, Live Demos, and Awards
phases.description: Finalist teams present live demos to an independent technical jury. Winners receive cash prizes, compute credits, and conference travel grants.

rubric.description: Novelty of the computational approach, algorithmic efficiency, and sophistication of photonics modeling.
Readable, modular codebase with comprehensive docstrings, unit tests, and accessible getting-started tutorials.
Practical usefulness of the tool or model for researchers, students, and engineers in the photonics ecosystem.
Clear benchmark comparisons against established analytical formulas or numerical simulation ground truth.

awards.reward: Grand Trophy, Cash Award, and Conference Travel Fellowship
awards.perks: Priority integration into Optica Egypt open toolstack and cloud compute credits.

awards.reward: Distinguished Excellence Award and Project Grant
awards.perks: Direct mentorship pairing with international research laboratories.

awards.reward: Best AI Model, Best Tool Documentation, and Best Open Dataset
awards.perks: Optica membership sponsorship and official publication recognition.

relatedContests.name: Egypt Photonic Chipathon
relatedContests.description: Annual nationwide PIC layout competition where university teams submit DRC-clean silicon designs for subsidized multi-project wafer (MPW) fabrication.

relatedContests.name: Student Capstone and Poster Championship
relatedContests.description: Annual competition celebrating the best bachelor graduation capstones, master research posters, and optical engineering prototypes across Egyptian universities.
